---
format:
  html:
    toc: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrors: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ["nav#TOC a.nav-link.active"]
        - ["nav#TOC [data-toc-expanded]"]
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['<a href="#outer" class="nav-link active" data-scroll-target="#outer">']
        - ['data-toc-expanded', 'data-quarto-component']
---

bd-toc-scrollspy-js-41e624d8. Without `toc-expand` no attribute is
written (the script defaults to depth 1, as Q1 does), and without
`toc-component` the nav carries no component host attribute.

The regex pins the first entry as the one marked active at render time.
The live-DOM check only asks that some entry is active: once the script
runs (the hub-client runner), which entry depends on the viewport, and a
page too short to scroll makes the last entry current, as Q1 does.
